verses.text: Tokwal tz'el yip spoder Jehová, yuj chi' maxtzak yal skolwaji, tokwal ix chakanhb'i Jehová, yuj chi' maxtzak yab' he tewi, maay.
Ha chukal tze k'ulej, a chi' ayek' t'a skal he nanhal yet' Dios. Ha juntzanh he mul chi', a tzek' makan t'a he kal yet' Dios chi', yuj chi' maxtzak yab' tas tzeyala'.
Ha ex tik, chik'tak he k'ab' he milancham anima, miktak he k'ab' he k'ulan chukal. Haxonhej es yet' chukal tz'elta t'a yol he ti'.

Malaj junok ex wach' tzeyutej he b'a. Max he ch'olb'itej yaj heb' anima t'a stojolal, ma t'a stzolal. Ha tas malaj yelk'ochi yet' esal lolonel, a tzeyak'lab'ej ayik sb'o yaj eyowal. Tze k'ulan chukal, yujto a chi' ayek' t'a he pensar.

Ha tas nab'il eyuuj chi', lajan wal icha snholob' nok' chan. Ha mach sloan snholob' nok' chan chi', schamnhej. Ayik smak'ji pojok, a nok' kotak ajawchan tz'elta t'a yool. Hanheja' tas nab'il eyuj chi', icha sch'al nok' xim yaji.
Ha sch'al nok' xim chi', max yal-laj sb'o pichul yet'ok, malaj mach spich sb'a yet' tas sb'o nok' chi'. Icha sch'al nok' xim chi', icha chi' juntzanh chukal tze k'ulej, malaj jab'ok tas tzeyik' t'ay.
Tzex b'at lemnaj t'a skal chukal. Elanhchamel tze milcham heb' anima malaj smul. Anhej t'a chukal ayoch he pensar, a b'aj tzex ek'i, jantak tastak tze satkaneli.
Anhej owal tzeyak'a', malaj jab'ok tojolal scheklaj t'a tas tze k'ulej. Ha he b'eyb'al chi', junelnhej manh wach'ok. Ha heb' tz'och tzak'an eyuuj, malaj jab'ok junk'olal tz'ilchaj yuj heb' t'ayex.

Yuj chi' syalan heb' anima icha tik: Malaj mach stek'b'an sb'a kuuj, malaj mach tzonh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzonh ixtani. Sko tanhwej tzalajk'olal, palta haxo kusk'olal hoyan och t'a ko patik. Sko tanhwej b'ak'inh tzonh kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzonh ixtani, palta malaj mach tzonh kolani.

Toxonhej sko machlej b'aj tzonh ek'i, icha yek' machmon junok mach max uji yilan t'a sat pat. Ha t'a chimk'ualil tzonh telwi, ichato t'ak'walil ayonhek'i. Wach'chom tek'an onh skab'i, palta ichato chamnak onhxo.

Ay b'aj skot kowal, snhiii yol ko jaj icha nok' oso, mato tzonh k'akwi icha nok' paramuch. Sko tanhwej ko ch'olb'itaj t'a stojolal, palta malaj b'ak'inh sb'o kaji. Sko tanhwej ko kolji, palta najat yajkanel t'ayonh.
Mamin Jehová, yel ix ko pitej ko b'a t'ayach. Ha ko mul chi' tz'ik'ankot t'a kib'anh. Chekel yaj ko pitalil, kojtak ko mul chi'.

Ach ko Diosal, te pit skutej ko b'a t'ayach, max ach ko k'anab'ajejlaj. Max ko nib'ejoch tzak'an ko b'a uuj. Anhej wal chukal yet' ixtoj anima sko k'an ko k'ulej. Nab'il kuuj tas tz'aj kak'an es yet' kixtan heb' ketanimail.
Sko chakel b'aj sb'o yaj heb' ketanimail. Ha tojolal, najat yajkanb'at kuuj. Ha tas yel, manhxalaj mach schaan yab' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima. Haxo tojolal chi', maxtzak cheklaj b'aj ay.

Manhxa mach tz'alan tas yel, haxo heb' snib'ej yaktankan chukal, tz'ik'jiek' tastak ay t'a heb', xchi heb' anima. Ha Jehová max scha sk'ol juntzanh tik, yujto maxtzak ch'olb'itaj heb' anima t'a stojolal.
Toxonhej sat sk'ol Jehová ayik syilani to malaj mach syak'lej sb'oan yaj jun tik. Yuj chi' syak'och sb'a skolan heb' yet' spoder, ol yak' ganar skolan heb'.

Icha heb' soldado ayoch spichul yik owal, icha chi' ol aj sjawi Jehová yet' yowal sk'ool, yik syak'an spak t'a heb' ixtum anima. Ha stojolal, icha k'een maklab' nhi' k'ol yaji. Haxo skolnab'il, lajan icha k'een xumpil.

Ol spakan t'a junjun mach, hato syala' tas sk'ulej. Ol yak'anoch syaelal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'ay, haton heb' kajan t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, ol yak' spak t'a heb' t'a smojal.

Masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, b'aj sk'eul k'u, masanto b'aj tz'em k'u, ayik ol yilanoch stzikikial Jehová heb', ol xiw heb', yujto ol ja icha wal junok ha' eluma', ichato pechb'il yuj junok owal ik'.
Ha Jehová tz'alani to ol jawok skol heb' aj Sion, haton heb' yinhtilal Jacob sna sb'a yuj schukal.

Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ha tiknaik tzin b'okan jun in trato heyet'ok, swak'ankan in ti' to a Wespíritu yet' in k'ayb'ub'al swak'kan t'ayex, ol kannhej heyet'ok. Ol eyalankan t'a heb' eyuninal yet' t'a heb' eyinhtilal ol elnhej, yik tze k'anab'ajej t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
